content.thinking: I'm checking whether the fix needs anything outside this repo. The change lives in scrape.yaml, which the platform applies through the shop's chart, and once it's merged and synced Prometheus should pick up the right port. The ServiceMonitor is also here and gets applied with the chart, so nothing external is needed. One thing to keep in mind is that main's values key path doesn't match the deployed revision, though the http-metrics port name is the same in both.

input.explanation: No. The ServiceMonitor that picks the scrape port by name is `deploy/scrape.yaml`, which lives in this repository. Its header comment says the platform applies it with the shop's chart. Changing its `port:` to `http-metrics` matches the name that `deploy/values-production.yaml` on main gives the metrics port. The investigation says the deployed revision c3c36da also uses that name. Once this merges and the platform syncs the chart as it usually does, Prometheus should find the endpoint again. Nothing outside this repository has to change. One caveat: c3c36da isn't in main's history. If that branch carries its own copy of scrape.yaml, it needs the same one-line change before it is deployed again.
